text: FAA guidance directs reestablishing the control link when a hazard occurs and, if the link cannot be reestablished, to initiate emergency/contingency procedures and discontinue flight until inspection; the remote PIC retains responsibility for safe operation. There is no usable evidence from Autel EVO Max 4N manuals in the collection. Incident reports (unverified) state loss of control shortly after takeoff, failed Return‑to‑Home attempts, and that the UAS platform has not been located or recovered. Main gap/conflict: FAA guidance emphasizes reestablishing or discontinuing the link with inspection, while unverified ASRS accounts describe loss of control with no recovery and the aircraft not located.
